items.text: The learning curve is doable but frustrating. It feels like the devs want you to fail right out of the gate. You need to make certain selections right out of the character creation if you are a new player you will 100% fail and you won't know why. Players that know what they are doing could still salvage a bad start though. I just don't feel like the game is worth wading through that crap for. I thought I'd like it after seeing gameplay but I just don't. I kept telling myself I'd like it once I got over the learning curve. I didn't.  I tried, the game just isn't fun. The final nail for me was fatigue. Not an enjoyable mechanic at all.
items.text_zh: 学习曲线是可以应付的，但令人沮丧。感觉开发者就想让你一出新手村就失败。作为新玩家，你必须在角色创建时做出某些特定选择，否则你100%会失败，而且你根本不知道为什么。知道自己在做什么的玩家或许还能挽救一个糟糕的开局。我只是觉得这游戏不值得熬过那些烂东西。看完实机演示后我以为我会喜欢它，但我就是不喜欢。我一直告诉自己，熬过学习曲线后我就会喜欢它。我并没有。我试过了，这游戏就是不好玩。压垮我的最后一根稻草是疲劳机制。完全不是一个有趣的机制。

observations.evidence: The final nail for me was fatigue. Not an enjoyable mechanic at all.
observations.evidence_zh: 对我来说最后一根稻草是疲劳。完全不是一个有趣的机制。
